assign.request: Graduate Menu, Pagination, Tags from ui/ templates to ux/ classes copying the ux/Tree split discipline (caller census, additive, CSS stays ui-*); assess Field validation honestly against the graduation rule; verify everything.
steps: read the exemplar: ux/Tree + ui/tree, and the three templates' actual logic
caller census -- grep public/ (skip ai/) for menu/pagination/tags classes and imports
class-name stamp check -- grep .menu .tags .pagination bare selectors
ui/menu, ui/pagination, ui/tags told the truth -- graduation pointer, byte-identical template
Field verdict -- log the argument, graduate only on a genuine YES
documentation per module, verification at 4 widths + interaction proofs + re-shoot ui/ pages

log.msg: CALLER CENSUS, menu -- ui/menu/menu.js:7-31 defines .ui-menu/.ui-menu-trigger/.ui-menu-list/.ui-menu-item (CSS only, no export). ui/menu/page.js:7-56 is the ONLY consumer (its own demo). ui/ui.js:19 imports menu.js for the site-wide CSS side effect. No other file under public/ (ai/ excluded) references ui-menu-* or imports menu.js. ext/layout/controls.js:22 exports an UNRELATED function also named menu() (a select-based multi-choice widget, class layout-pick) -- no shared classes, not a caller. Unlike ui/tree, menu.js exports NO function, so nothing needs to stay byte-compatible.

CALLER CENSUS, pagination -- ui/pagination/page.js is the ONLY file with pagination markup (pager/wired/context). No .ui-pagination class exists anywhere in public/ -- ui/doc/record.md:530 confirms it was dropped in the 2026-08-09 review as 'styled nowhere'. No ui.pagination() ever existed, no other caller.

CALLER CENSUS, tags -- ui/tags/page.js is the ONLY consumer of .ui-tags-input (parts.js:20, @layer util, READ-ONLY per fence) and the only tags-specific user of .ui-pill (parts.js:15). ui/ui.js:29 re-exports {css,component} from parts.js, which is how the site-wide CSS side effect loads. No ui.tags() ever existed, no other caller under public/ (ai/ excluded).

CLASS-NAME STAMP CHECK -- grepped every .css/.js under public/framework (ai/ excluded) for bare .menu, .tags, .pagination selectors: zero hits. classify() will stamp plain class Menu/.menu, class Pagination/.pagination, class Tags/.tags with no collision -- no UxMenu-style prefix needed.

FIELD VERDICT, the argument first -- ui/field has NO .js logic file at all (only page.js, a demo), so it has never held state across a render/update the way ui/tree's closure did. Its invalid variant is static markup (aria-invalid + an inline borderColor), computed once, not remembered. The one place validation genuinely lives is ux/Auth (Auth.js:5-9,101-112): native :user-invalid CSS (a platform pseudo-class the BROWSER computes from the form's own attributes, not JS-held state) plus a submit handler that reads element.validity and calls this.fail() -- workflow-level logic, exactly where ux/doc/system.md already says it belongs. :user-invalid/:invalid are named in the graduation rule's own does-not-count column alongside :hover/:focus-visible/<details>/<dialog> -- the platform's behavior, not a class's.

FIELD VERDICT: NO -- stays a template. ui/field graduates nothing (no state, no self-installed listener, no lifecycle -- all three graduation criteria miss). Matches the default this wave's brief set and confirms ux/Auth's existing precedent (Auth's readme.md:26-27 already documents novalidate + :user-invalid as the pattern). ux/Field/** untouched, per fence.

NEEDED CHANGE for the mastermind (ux/page.js, ux/readme.md are READ-ONLY per fence) -- both now undercount: ux/page.js:32 'Five classes live here now' and its ui.table() row ['today','20 components','5'] (line ~43), ux/readme.md:6 'Five shipped 2026-08-21 ... Auth, Wizard, Tree, Course, Filter' and its table row + 'today | 5' (lines 6,14), and readme.md's 'The five:' list (line 52) should all read EIGHT and add Menu, Pagination, Tags to the named list once someone is in either file. Not touched here -- both are outside this task's fence.

TRAP FOUND + FIXED -- doc/decisions.md links for a Page-based module (Menu/Pagination/Tags, and Tree before them) are NOT SPA routes; only a Doc-based module (ux/ itself, ui/ itself, via notes:) registers a trailing-slash /doc/<name>/ route. Cross-module links in ui/menu/page.js, ui/pagination/page.js, ui/tags/page.js first wrote /framework/ux/<Name>/doc/decisions/ (trailing slash, no .md) -- console showed 'Error: 404 -- nothing matches' on load. Fixed to the literal file path /framework/ux/<Name>/doc/decisions.md (text/markdown, 200, no app error), matching the relative ./doc/decisions.md form ux/Tree's own files already used. Verified all 3 with curl content-type + headless console check.

assign.outcome:
**Menu, Pagination and Tags graduated to ux/ -- three clean classes, zero named extensions, Field stays a template.** Same split ux/Tree proved: CSS stays `ui-*` in ui/, only state/listeners/lifecycle become a class, every ui/ page still renders byte-identical.

![](tags-added.png)

- [ux/Menu](/framework/ux/Menu/) -- open/pick/close + click-outside (the template never had light-dismiss); `pick(item)` is the seam
- [ux/Pagination](/framework/ux/Pagination/) -- `current` remembered as a NUMBER (the removed function's bug fixed), `go(n)` drives a real list via `onChange`
- [ux/Tags](/framework/ux/Tags/) -- `add()`/`drop()` wire the inert `x` and field; `Tags.Chip` is the one real part this wave (owns its own listener)
- ui/ told the truth: [ui/menu](/framework/ui/menu/), [ui/pagination](/framework/ui/pagination/), [ui/tags](/framework/ui/tags/) each got the Tree-shaped graduation pointer, minimal edits, no readme existed to edit for any of the three
- Docs: readme + [Menu decisions](/framework/ux/Menu/doc/decisions.md), [Pagination decisions](/framework/ux/Pagination/doc/decisions.md), [Tags decisions](/framework/ux/Tags/doc/decisions.md)

**Caller census (logged before the first class was written):** none of the three ever had a `ui.<name>()` export or a caller outside their own demo page -- unlike `ui/tree`'s `tree()` (kept for `ext/Playground`), nothing needed to stay byte-compatible. Class-name stamp check: `.menu`/`.pagination`/`.tags` all zero collisions, plain names shipped.

**Field verdict: NO, stays a template.** ui/field has no `.js` logic file at all -- no state, no listener, no lifecycle. Its validation lives in ux/Auth already: native `:user-invalid` (the platform's behavior, explicitly excluded by the graduation rule) plus a workflow-level submit handler. Argued in full in the log before the verdict line.

**No named extensions.** Neither module's own doc asks for one the way ui/tree's readme named keyboard roving -- logged and shipped as three clean bases instead of six thin subclasses. `Pagination.Button` considered and rejected (no per-button branching, unlike `Tags.Chip`).

**Two traps found and fixed, both logged for their skills:** `View.classify()` reads back `this.name` (not just shadowed methods) -- a `Tags.Chip` built with `{ name }` silently wore its own tag text as a CSS class; renamed to `value`. And a `doc/decisions.md` beside a `Page`-based module has no SPA route -- three cross-module links first used the trailing-slash form and 404d in console; fixed to the literal `.md` path.

**Verified:** 360/768/1280/3440 on all three new pages plus the words proof, zero overflow, zero console errors (LiveReload WS noise excluded) on all six touched pages at 1600. Interaction proofs headless: menu open->pick->closed->reopen->click-outside-closed; pagination click page 3 -> list + `.prim` both move; tags type+Enter->added+refocused, x-click->removed. All three re-shot `ui/*` pages confirm byte-identical templates plus the new pointer section.

**Left, logged for the mastermind:** `ux/page.js` and `ux/readme.md` (both read-only per fence) still say "Five classes" / "5" -- now eight; needs an editor in either file.
